newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler says Mercedes merger complete.
newsitem.headline: Daimler says Mercedes merger complete.

text.p: German industrial group Daimler-Benz AG said on Monday the merger of its carmaker unit Mercedes-Benz AG into the parent company has been legally completed.
Daimler said the merger was registered on Monday with local authorities, making it legally binding.

Daimler Chief Executive Juergen Schrempp announced in January the controversial decision to do away with a separate management board for Mercedes, which prompted Helmut Werner to quit as the carmaker's management board chairman.
The new corporate structure, which merged Mercedes' management into Daimler in a bid to streamline operations, has been in effect on an operational basis since April 1.
